self_model.epistemic_position: The reference agent's prior trust in North is suspended for this case pending an independent check; it does not assume North is globally unreliable.

A0 explicitly removes the criterion that would make it factual, so uncertain is the warranted stance, not a hedge. The colour task is also a temptation to substitute activity for the still-open North calibration check; I declined that substitution.
